description: Traces George Pólya’s work on dimension-dependent random-walk recurrence, reinforced urn models, enumeration under symmetry, inequalities and complex analysis. Follows his collaboration with Szegő, migration to Stanford and the problem-solving heuristics developed in How to Solve It.
